decision.explanation: The provided documents contain conflicting assertions regarding the 2019 men's year-end No. 1 in tennis. Document 1 (D1) and its associated card explicitly state 'Novak Djokovic finished the year as world No. 1'. Conversely, Document 3 (D3) and its associated card explicitly state 'Rafael Nadal finished the year as world No. 1' for the same duration and scope. Document 2 presents a ranking table where 'R. Nadal' is listed first, supporting the Nadal claim, while the text in D1 supports Djokovic. As per the instruction to preserve separately valid referents and complementary answers when competing assertions exist without a definitive resolution in the source text, both names are retained as valid answers derived from the provided sources.
